news.full_article_text: No environmental nod needed for heliport or helipad projects: Govt The Union environment ministry has said that no prior environmental clearance under the Environment Impact Assessment (EIA) Notification, 2006, is needed to set up heliports and helipads because these were not listed in its Schedule The Union environment ministry has said that no prior environmental clearance under the Environment Impact Assessment (EIA) Notification, 2006, is needed to set up heliports and helipads because these were not listed in its Schedule. In an office memorandum dated October 27, the ministry said it had received requests from various stakeholders seeking clarification on the applicability of EIA Notification, 2006, for setting up of heliports or helipads. “As per extant provisions, heliports or helipads are not listed in the schedule of the EIA Notification, 2006. This is issued with the approval of the competent authority.” the memorandum said. Experts said while helipads and heliports are not explicitly mentioned under the notification, building and construction projects over 20,000 sqms still require an EC. “So if the built-up area of the helipad or heliport is above 20,000 sqm, it will still require an EC as per 8(a) of the Schedule. This is the same case with data centres currently,” said Debadityo Sinha, lead, climate and ecosystems at Vidhi Centre for Legal Policy. In a reply in parliament on August 6, the ministry had earlier clarified how Artificial Intelligence (AI) data Centres do not require EC under the EIA Notification, 2006, specifying the only exception was the area. “However, AI Data Centres proposed as part of a “Building and Construction Project” under Item 8(a), i.e. built up area exceeding 20,000 sq. m or a “Township and Area Development Project” i.e. covering an area ≥ 50 ha and /or built up area ≥ 1,50,000 sq. m under Item 8(b) of the schedule to the EIA Notification, 2006 require prior EC,” it had said.

news.full_article_text: As Maoist shadow fades, Chhattisgarh opens Indravati tiger reserve to tourists OP Yadav, PCCF (Wildlife), said opening the tiger reserve to tourists was an important step to promote eco-tourism and showcase the rich biodiversity of the region Chhattisgarh on Sunday opened the Indravati Tiger Reserve in Bastar’s Bijapur to tourists, allowing organised wildlife tourism in one of the state’s most remote forests for the first time in four decades. The move, timed to coincide with Chhattisgarh’s statehood day, comes amid a significant improvement in the security situation in context of Left Wing Extremism, which has allowed officials to access areas that had remained beyond their reach for years.Bijapur in Chhattisgarh’s Bastar region was among the districts known as the epicentre of the Maoist insurgency in the state. OP Yadav, principal chief conservator of forests (Wildlife), Chhattisgarh, said opening the tiger reserve to tourists was an important step to promote eco-tourism and showcase the rich biodiversity of the region. “At the same time, our focus will remain on ensuring that local communities benefit from tourism activities,” Yadav said. The Indravati reserve, spread over 2,800sq km, was established under Project Tiger in 1983, and is the country’s fourth-largest tiger reserve in India in terms of area. It is home to tigers, leopards, wild buffaloes, gaur, chital and several other wildlife species. A presentation made by the forest department puts the number of tigers in Indravati at six in the current state-level figures presented to the minister. The chart records 18 tigers in Achanakmar, seven in Guru Ghasidas-Tamor Pingla, three in Bhoramdev and one in Udanti-Sitanadi. The figure of six, however, comes with a caveat. The latest All India Tiger Estimation is currently under way and officials said the final tiger population for Indravati can be confirmed only after the exercise and scientific compilation of data are completed. Earlier assessments were conducted only across accessible areas while improved field access is expected to provide a more comprehensive assessment. Yadav said they would adopt a step-by-step approach. In the first phase, a 33-km safari route has been identified in the buffer area. A nine-km stretch from Ullur village to Dandaparti has been prepared for visitors, officials said. “We are starting the safari on a limited scale. Four Gypsy vehicles will operate in the first phase and the number will be increased depending on tourist response and footfall. More routes will also be developed subsequently,” Yadav said. The initial safari fee has been fixed at ₹ 2,000 per vehicle per day. The initiative is also expected to create employment opportunities for local communities. Six local youths have been trained and engaged as guides and safari vehicle drivers. “Local participation is an important component of the eco-tourism plan. Training local youths as guides and drivers will provide them with livelihood opportunities while also allowing visitors to understand the forest and its biodiversity through local knowledge,” Yadav said. The government is also promoting homestays, traditional handicrafts, local products, Bastar art and indigenous cuisine as part of the wider eco-tourism initiative. Officials said these activities would create self-employment opportunities for villagers and strengthen the local economy. The safari has been developed as part of a larger eco-tourism circuit covering several natural attractions in the region. One of the key attractions is the Madhi Markha eco-tourism site, located around 20 km from Bhopalpattnam along the Indravati river. The site is known for its sandy riverbank and rocky terrain. Another major attraction is the Nambi waterfall in the Usur area. Surrounded by dense forests, the waterfall is around 300 feet high and is being promoted as a destination for visitors to the region. “Indravati has enormous potential for eco-tourism because of its forests, rivers, waterfalls and wildlife. The aim is to develop these destinations in a responsible manner without compromising the conservation of the reserve,” Yadav said. The reserve and surrounding areas are also home to the wild buffalo, the state animal of Chhattisgarh, as well as Indian and white-rumped vultures and several other species. The initiative is expected to give visitors access to a largely unexplored forest landscape while creating new economic opportunities for communities living around the reserve. “The reopening of Indravati is also a reflection of the changing situation in the region. We want conservation, tourism and local livelihoods to move together,” Yadav said. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Ritesh Mishra Ritesh Mishra is the State Correspondent for Chhattisgarh with Hindustan Times. He reports on Maoism, internal security, politics, mining, governance, and major developments shaping the state. Based in Raipur, he has covered Chhattisgarh since 2016, reporting extensively from the Bastar region and other conflict-affected areas. With nearly two decades of experience in journalism, Ritesh has built a reputation for ground reporting from some of India's most challenging terrains. His coverage spans Left-Wing Extremism, counter-insurgency operations, elections, tribal affairs, environmental issues, infrastructure, mining, and socio-economic developments. He has reported on major security operations, policy initiatives, wildlife crime, and the changing dynamics of conflict and development in Central India. Before moving to Chhattisgarh, Ritesh spent eight years reporting from Madhya Pradesh, covering politics, administration, crime, development, and social issues. Throughout his career, he has reported on various forms of extremism in Central India, combining field reporting with in-depth analysis to produce accurate, balanced, and impactful journalism. Prior to joining Hindustan Times, Ritesh worked with The Pioneer and The Free Press Journal, where he covered a wide range of beats and honed his skills in political, investigative, and field reporting. His reporting is marked by exclusive stories, extensive fieldwork, and a commitment to factual, on-the-ground journalism that brings complex issues to a wider audience. Read More

news.headline: Supreme Court Upholds Reopening of Income Tax Assessments in 2010 Delhi Real Estate Transaction
news.story_lead: The Supreme Court of India has dismissed appeals filed by the sons of former Chief Justice of India YK Sabharwal, clearing the path for the Income Tax Department to reopen tax assessments related to a 2010 prime property deal in New Delhi. A two-judge bench ruled that investigation reports provided tangible material justifying the reassessment, clarifying key legal standards under Section 147 of the Income Tax Act.
news.full_article_text:
### Supreme Court Ruling on Reassessment under Section 147

A two-judge bench of the Supreme Court, comprising Justice JB Pardiwala and Justice K Vinod Chandran, has dismissed four appeals filed by Chetan Sabharwal and Nitin Sabharwal. The judgment upholds notices issued in March 2015 by the Income Tax Department's assessing officer (AO) to reopen tax assessments for Financial Years 2007–08 and 2008–09 (corresponding to Assessment Years 2008–09 and 2009–10). This decision vacates a stay on reassessment proceedings that had been granted by the apex court in August and September 2019.

### Key Facts of the Share Transaction and Property Purchase
* **Share Sale Agreement (October 2007):** Chetan and Nitin Sabharwal, along with two other shareholders, sold their stakes in two entities—Pawan Impex Pvt Ltd (valued at ₹195 crore) and SVIIT Software Pvt Ltd (valued at ₹60 crore)—to GYS Real Estate Pvt Ltd. The aggregate deal value was ₹255 crore, with each brother entitled to a 25% share of the consideration.
* **Property Acquisition (April 2010):** The brothers jointly purchased an undivided 50% share in a residential property located on Sikandra Road in Lutyens' Delhi for ₹61 crore (with the full property acquired alongside developer Kabul Chawla for approximately ₹122 crore).
* **Tax Exemption Claim:** The brothers claimed capital gains tax exemption under Section 54F of the Income Tax Act, 1961, by linking the proceeds from the share transactions to the residential property purchase made within two years.

### Findings of the Income Tax Investigation
* The Director General of Income Tax (Investigation) subsequently audited the transactions and found that the share valuation was substantially higher than could be justified by the cost of underlying land and buildings.
* The department noted that substantial proceeds were channelled into prime real estate under the cover of share transfers, providing a prima facie justification to believe that income chargeable to tax had escaped assessment.

### Legal Ratios Established by the Supreme Court
1. **Interpretation of 'Reason to Believe' (Section 147):** The bench clarified that 'reason to believe' requires tangible material showing a live link or rational nexus to the escapement of income. The Assessing Officer is not required to conclusively establish escapement via complete legal proof at the notice stage.
2. **Reassessment vs. Review:** The court highlighted that reopening an assessment based on fresh material from an investigation report does not amount to a mere 'change of opinion' or an improper review of an earlier assessment.
3. **Section 143(1) vs. Section 143(3) Scrutiny:**
   * For Nitin Sabharwal, original returns were merely processed via intimation under Section 143(1). As no formal scrutiny assessment or opinion was recorded initially, the defense of 'change of opinion' was legally untenable.
   * For Chetan Sabharwal, whose returns underwent scrutiny under Section 143(3), the court observed that original assessment orders showed no conscious application of mind to share valuation, asset proceeds, or Section 54F exemption eligibility, allowing subsequent investigation findings to validly form the basis for reopening.

hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### धारा 147 के तहत पुनर्मूल्यांकन पर सर्वोच्च न्यायालय का फैसला

जस्टिस जे.बी. पारदीवाला और जस्टिस के. विनोद चंद्रन की दो सदस्यीय सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की पीठ ने चेतन सब्रवाल और नितिन सब्रवाल द्वारा दायर चार अपीलों को खारिज कर दिया है। यह फैसला वित्तीय वर्ष 2007-08 और 2008-09 (कर निर्धारण वर्ष 2008-09 और 2009-10) के कर मूल्यांकनों को फिर से खोलने के लिए आयकर विभाग के आकलन अधिकारी (AO) द्वारा मार्च 2015 में जारी नोटिस की वैधता को बरकरार रखता है।

### शेयर सौदे और संपत्ति खरीद के मुख्य तथ्य
* **शेयर बिक्री समझौता (अक्टूबर 2007):** चेतन और नितिन सब्रवाल ने दो अन्य शेयरधारकों के साथ मिलकर दो कंपनियों—पवन इंपेक्स प्राइवेट लिमिटेड (मूल्य ₹195 करोड़) और एसवीआईआईटी सॉफ्टवेयर प्राइवेट लिमिटेड (मूल्य ₹60 करोड़)—में अपनी हिस्सेदारी जीवाईएस रियल एस्टेट प्राइवेट लिमिटेड को बेची। कुल सौदा मूल्य ₹255 करोड़ था, जिसमें प्रत्येक भाई को 25% हिस्सा प्राप्त होना था।
* **संपत्ति अधिग्रहण (अप्रैल 2010):** दोनों भाइयों ने लुटियंस दिल्ली के सिकंदरा रोड पर स्थित एक आवासीय संपत्ति में ₹61 करोड़ में संयुक्त रूप से 50% अविभाजित हिस्सा खरीदा (पूरी संपत्ति डेवलपर काबुल चावला के साथ मिलकर लगभग ₹122 करोड़ में खरीदी गई थी)।
* **कर छूट का दावा:** भाइयों ने आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 54F के तहत पूंजीगत लाभ कर छूट का दावा किया, जिसमें दो साल के भीतर खरीदी गई आवासीय संपत्ति से शेयर सौदे की आय को जोड़ा गया था।

### आयकर जांच के निष्कर्ष
* आयकर महानिदेशक (जांच) की रिपोर्ट में पाया गया कि शेयरों का मूल्यांकन अंतर्निहित भूमि और भवनों की लागत की तुलना में काफी अधिक था।
* विभाग ने उल्लेख किया कि शेयर हस्तांतरण के नाम पर पर्याप्त राशि को प्राइम रियल एस्टेट में लगाया गया था, जिससे यह मानने का प्राथमिक आधार मिला कि कर योग्य आय का निर्धारण छूट गया था।

### सुप्रीम कोर्ट द्वारा स्थापित कानूनी सिद्धांत
1. **'विश्वास करने का कारण' (धारा 147) की व्याख्या:** पीठ ने स्पष्ट किया कि 'कारण' का अर्थ ठोस सामग्री है, जिसका आय छूटने के विश्वास से सीधा संबंध होना चाहिए। नोटिस जारी करने के चरण में आकलन अधिकारी को कानूनी साक्ष्यों के माध्यम से आय छूटने को पूरी तरह साबित करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
2. **पुनर्मूल्यांकन बनाम समीक्षा:** अदालत ने जोर दिया कि नई जांच रिपोर्ट के आधार पर मूल्यांकन फिर से खोलना केवल 'राय का बदलाव' या पिछले फैसले की समीक्षा नहीं माना जा सकता।
3. **धारा 143(1) बनाम धारा 143(3) की जांच:**
   * नितिन सब्रवाल के मामले में, मूल रिटर्न केवल धारा 143(1) के तहत स्वीकार किए गए थे। चूंकि शुरू में कोई औपचारिक जांच या राय दर्ज नहीं की गई थी, इसलिए राय बदलने का तर्क कानूनी रूप से निराधार था।
   * चेतन सब्रवाल के मामले में, जिनके रिटर्न की जांच धारा 143(3) के तहत हुई थी, अदालत ने पाया कि मूल आदेशों में शेयर मूल्यांकन या धारा 54F छूट की पात्रता पर कोई स्पष्ट विचार नहीं किया गया था, इसलिए बाद की जांच रिपोर्ट पुनर्मूल्यांकन का वैध आधार बनी।

quiz.question: Regarding the reopening of income tax assessments under Section 147 of the Income Tax Act, 1961, which legal requirement was highlighted by the Supreme Court in this judgment?
options: The Assessing Officer must possess conclusive legal proof of tax evasion before issuing a reassessment notice.
The Assessing Officer must have tangible material establishing a live link to the reasonable belief that income escaped assessment.
An intimation under Section 143(1) prevents the tax department from ever issuing a notice under Section 147.
Reassessment proceedings under Section 147 can be initiated solely on the basis of a change of opinion by a new Assessing Officer.
quiz.correct_answer: The Assessing Officer must have tangible material establishing a live link to the reasonable belief that income escaped assessment.
quiz.explanation: The Supreme Court clarified that 'reason to believe' under Section 147 requires tangible material with a rational connection or live link to the belief of income escapement. news.story_lead: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit has assumed charge as the 29th Chief of Air Staff of the Indian Air Force, succeeding Air Chief Marshal AP Singh following his retirement after 42 years of service. Taking leadership at a crucial juncture, the new Air Chief faces the immediate priority of accelerating key aircraft acquisition and modernisation programmes to address squadron shortages, while also advancing tri-service theaterisation reforms.
news.full_article_text:
### Leadership Transition at Indian Air Force
Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit officially took charge as the 29th Chief of Air Staff (CAS) of the Indian Air Force (IAF), succeeding Air Chief Marshal AP Singh, who retired after a distinguished 42-year military career. Prior to assuming the top position, Dixit served as the Vice Chief of Air Staff.

### Career Background and Operational Experience
Commissioned into the IAF's fighter stream in December 1986, the 59-year-old officer is an experimental test pilot and qualified flying instructor with over 3,500 flying hours. His operational flight experience spans multiple platforms, including the Mirage-2000, various MiG variants, Jaguar, and the indigenous Tejas Light Combat Aircraft (LCA Mk-1).

Throughout his four-decade career, Air Chief Marshal Dixit has held critical operational and staff positions. His previous key assignments include Chief of Integrated Defence Staff to the Chairman, Chiefs of Staff Committee (CISC), Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief of Central Air Command, Deputy Chief of Air Staff, Air Defence Commander of Southern Air Command, and Senior Air Staff Officer at South Western Air Command. He has also commanded a Mirage-2000 squadron and a fighter training base in the southern sector.

Dixit has participated in key military operations, including Operation Safed Sagar during the Kargil Conflict and Operation Rakshak in Jammu and Kashmir. As CISC, he oversaw operational planning during Operation Sindoor, the four-day military confrontation with Pakistan following the Pahalgam terror attack. Academically, he is an alumnus of the National Defence Academy (NDA), Defence Services Command and Staff College (Bangladesh), and the National Defence College (NDC).

### Strategic Priorities and Modernisation Roadmap
Air Chief Marshal Dixit assumes command amid a critical shortage of fighter jet squadrons, which risks falling below 30 against the sanctioned operational requirement of 42.5 squadrons. Five major aircraft acquisition and development programmes are set to be prioritised under his leadership:
1. **LCA Mk-1A**: Immediate priority for induction to replace retired MiG-21 fleets. Two orders placed with Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) total 180 aircraft worth ₹1.1 lakh crore (83 ordered in February 2021 and 97 in September 2025). Engine supply delays involving GE Aerospace's F404-IN20 engines have stabilised, and HAL aims to deliver approximately 10 aircraft in FY 2026-27.
2. **LCA Mk-2**: Advanced single-engine medium-weight fighter development.
3. **Multi-Role Fighter Aircraft (MRFA)**: Proposed procurement of 114 Rafale jets from France worth approximately ₹3.25 lakh crore. Under the planned model, 18 jets will be delivered in fly-away condition and 96 will be manufactured in India by Dassault Aviation and a domestic partner.
4. **Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA)**: India's indigenous fifth-generation stealth fighter project.
5. **Medium Transport Aircraft (MTA)**: Programme aimed at modernising tactical air mobility fleets.

Besides procurement, the new Air Chief takes office during ongoing discussions regarding tri-service theaterisation and a local administrative matter involving the reclamation of land at the Race Course Air Force Station in Delhi.
news.background_context: The IAF is managing a structural deficit in combat squadrons following the phase-out of legacy aircraft such as the MiG-21, which served for over six decades. Former Air Chief Marshal AP Singh noted that India requires an annual production rate of up to 40 aircraft to effectively bridge operational capability gaps.

hindi_translation.story_lead: एयर चीफ मार्शल आशुतोष दीक्षित ने भारतीय वायु सेना के 29वें वायु सेना अध्यक्ष (CAS) के रूप में कार्यभार ग्रहण कर लिया है। उन्होंने एयर चीफ मार्शल एपी सिंह का स्थान लिया जो 42 वर्षों की सैन्य सेवा के बाद सेवानिवृत्त हुए। नए वायु सेना प्रमुख के समक्ष लड़ाकू विमानों की कमी को दूर करने के लिए प्रमुख अधिग्रहण और आधुनिकीकरण कार्यक्रमों में तेजी लाने तथा थियेटराइजेशन सुधारों को आगे बढ़ाने की महत्वपूर्ण जिम्मेदारी है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### भारतीय वायु सेना में नेतृत्व परिवर्तन
एयर चीफ मार्शल आशुतोष दीक्षित ने भारतीय वायु सेना के 29वें वायु सेना अध्यक्ष (CAS) का पदभार संभाल लिया है। उन्होंने एयर चीफ मार्शल एपी सिंह का स्थान लिया, जो 42 वर्ष की सेवा के बाद सेवानिवृत्त हुए। पदभार संभालने से पहले दीक्षित वायु सेना के उप प्रमुख (Vice Chief of Air Staff) के रूप में कार्यरत थे।

### करियर और परिचालन अनुभव
दिसंबर 1986 में वायु सेना की फाइटर स्ट्रीम में कमीशन प्राप्त 59 वर्षीय अधिकारी आशुतोष दीक्षित एक प्रायोगिक टेस्ट पायलट और योग्य फ्लाइंग इंस्ट्रक्टर हैं। उनके पास मिराज-2000, मिग के विभिन्न वेरिएंट, जगुआर और स्वदेशी तेजस एलसीए मार्क-1 सहित विभिन्न विमानों पर 3,500 से अधिक उड़ानों का अनुभव है।

अपने चार दशक के करियर में उन्होंने कई महत्वपूर्ण पदों पर कार्य किया है। वह चीफ्स ऑफ स्टाफ कमेटी (CISC) के अध्यक्ष के लिए एकीकृत रक्षा स्टाफ के प्रमुख, मध्य वायु कमान के एयर ऑफिसर कमांडिंग-इन-चीफ और उप वायु सेना प्रमुख रह चुके हैं। उन्होंने कारगिल युद्ध के दौरान 'ऑपरेशन सफेद सागर' और जम्मू-कश्मीर में 'ऑपरेशन रक्षक' में भाग लिया। इसके अलावा, पिछले साल पहलगाम आतंकी हमले के बाद पाकिस्तान के साथ हुए चार दिवसीय सैन्य टकराव 'ऑपरेशन सिंदूर' के दौरान वह CISC के पद पर कार्यरत थे।

### रणनीतिक प्राथमिकताएं और आधुनिकीकरण रोडमैप
नए वायु सेना प्रमुख ऐसे समय में कमान संभाल रहे हैं जब वायु सेना में लड़ाकू विमानों की स्वीकृत 42.5 स्क्वाड्रन क्षमता के मुकाबले स्क्वाड्रन संख्या 30 से नीचे गिरने का जोखिम है। उनके नेतृत्व में पांच प्रमुख विमान कार्यक्रमों को प्राथमिकता दी जाएगी:
1. **LCA Mk-1A**: सेवानिवृत्त मिग-21 बेड़े की जगह शामिल करने की तत्काल प्राथमिकता। एचएएल को ₹1.1 लाख करोड़ के कुल 180 विमानों के दो ऑर्डर दिए जा चुके हैं।
2. **LCA Mk-2**: उन्नत मध्यम वजन वाले लड़ाकू विमान का विकास।
3. **MRFA**: फ्रांस से ₹3.25 लाख करोड़ की अनुमानित लागत पर 114 राफेल विमानों की प्रस्तावित खरीद, जिसमें 96 विमान भारत में बनाए जाएंगे।
4. **AMCA**: भारत का स्वदेशी पांचवीं पीढ़ी का स्टील्थ फाइटर प्रोजेक्ट।
5. **MTA**: मध्यम परिवहन विमान आधुनिकीकरण कार्यक्रम।

news.headline: New IAF Chief Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit Unveils 'VAYU' Strategic Vision
news.story_lead: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit has assumed charge as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff, succeeding Air Chief Marshal AP Singh who retired after 42 years of service. In his maiden address at Air Force Station in New Delhi, the Air Chief Marshal outlined the 'VAYU' vision to drive combat readiness, self-reliance, technological innovation, and joint operational capabilities.
news.full_article_text:
### Operational Priorities: The 'VAYU' Vision

During a Guard of Honour ceremony at the Parade Ground of Air Force Station, New Delhi, the newly appointed Chief of the Air Staff, Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit, presented his strategic framework for the Indian Air Force (IAF), summarized by the acronym **'VAYU'**:

*   **V - Vigilance and Readiness:** Emphasizing constant operational preparedness across all fighter squadrons, radar stations, and air defence units. A primary objective under this pillar is restoring the IAF's sanctioned combat squadron strength.
*   **A - Aatmanirbharta (Self-reliance):** Prioritizing indigenous platforms and weapons systems, including the Tejas Light Combat Aircraft (LCA) Mk1A and Mk II, the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA), alongside domestic sensors and munitions to ensure operational sustainment and strategic deterrence.
*   **Y - Yukti (Ingenuity & Innovation):** Modernizing tactical doctrines and procedures through AI-enabled networked command-and-control systems, multi-layered counter-drone architectures, agile force protection, and expanding operational capabilities into near-space domains.
*   **U - Unity of Effort:** Aligning IAF operations with the national defense vision of Jointness, Aatmanirbharta, and Innovation (JAI) by fostering seamless tri-service integration with the Indian Army, Indian Navy, and strategic national agencies.

### Modern Warfare Dynamics and Technology Integration

Air Chief Marshal Dixit highlighted that emerging technologies are fundamentally altering the character of modern conflict. He noted that threat environments are increasingly shaped by multi-domain capabilities, including unmanned aerial vehicles (drones), long-range precision munitions, cyber warfare, space systems, artificial intelligence, and spectrum-level electronic warfare. To maintain strategic superiority over the coming decade, the IAF must continuously adapt its technological and tactical posture.

### Profile of the 29th Chief of the Air Staff

*   **Commissioning & Experience:** Commissioned into the IAF fighter stream in December 1986, the 59-year-old commander is an Experimental Test Pilot and Qualified Flying Instructor with over 3,500 flight hours across platforms such as the Mirage-2000, various MiG variants, Jaguar, and the Tejas LCA Mk-1.
*   **Key Military Roles:** Prior to becoming the Air Chief, he served as Vice Chief of the Air Staff, Chief of Integrated Defence Staff to the Chairman, Chiefs of Staff Committee (CISC), Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief of Central Air Command, and Deputy Chief of the Air Staff.
*   **Operational History:** He participated in Operation Safed Sagar during the 1999 Kargil War, Operation Rakshak in Jammu and Kashmir, and served as CISC during Operation Sindoor, the four-day military confrontation with Pakistan following the Pahalgam terror attack.

hindi_translation.headline: नए वायु सेना प्रमुख एयर चीफ मार्शल आशुतोष दीक्षित ने रणनीतिक 'वायु' (VAYU) विजन का अनावरण किया
hindi_translation.story_lead: एयर चीफ मार्शल आशुतोष दीक्षित ने 42 वर्षों की सेवा के बाद सेवानिवृत्त हुए एयर चीफ मार्शल ए.पी. सिंह का स्थान लेते हुए 29वें वायु सेना प्रमुख के रूप में कार्यभार संभाला है। नई दिल्ली स्थित एयर फोर्स स्टेशन में अपने पहले संबोधन में, उन्होंने युद्ध तत्परता, आत्मनिर्भरता, तकनीकी नवाचार और संयुक्त अभियानों को बढ़ावा देने के लिए 'वायु' (VAYU) विजन की रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत की।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### परिचालन प्राथमिकताएं: 'वायु' (VAYU) विजन

नई दिल्ली के एयर फोर्स स्टेशन स्थित परेड ग्राउंड में गार्ड ऑफ ऑनर समारोह के दौरान, नव नियुक्त वायु सेना प्रमुख एयर चीफ मार्शल आशुतोष दीक्षित ने भारतीय वायु सेना (IAF) के लिए अपना रणनीतिक खाका पेश किया, जिसे **'VAYU'** शब्द से संक्षेपित किया गया है:

*   **V - विजिलेंस एंड रेडिनेस (सतर्कता और तत्परता):** सभी लड़ाकू स्क्वाड्रनों, रडार स्टेशनों और वायु रक्षा इकाइयों में निरंतर परिचालन तैयारियों पर जोर देना। स्वीकृत लड़ाकू स्क्वाड्रन क्षमता को पुनः प्राप्त करना प्राथमिक लक्ष्य है।
*   **A - आत्मनिर्भरता:** तेजस एलसीए Mk1A और Mk II, एडवांस्ड मीडियम कॉम्बैट एयरक्राफ्ट (AMCA), स्वदेशी सेंसर और हथियारों सहित घरेलू लड़ाकू प्लेटफॉर्मों को प्राथमिकता देना ताकि परिचालन आत्मनिर्भरता और विश्वसनीय निवारक क्षमता सुनिश्चित की जा सके।
*   **Y - युक्ति (नवाचार एवं बुद्धिमत्ता):** एआई-सक्षम नेटवर्क कमांड-एंड-कंट्रोल सिस्टम, बहुस्तरीय काउंटर-ड्रोन सुरक्षा, त्वरित रखरखाव और नियर-स्पेस (समीप-अंतरिक्ष) परिचालन क्षेत्रों के उपयोग के माध्यम से सामरिक सिद्धांतों और प्रक्रियाओं का आधुनिकीकरण करना।
*   **U - यूनिटी ऑफ एफर्ट (प्रयासों की एकजुटता):** 'JAI' (संयुक्तता, आत्मनिर्भरता और नवाचार) के राष्ट्रीय दृष्टिकोण के अनुरूप भारतीय सेना, भारतीय नौसेना और राष्ट्रीय एजेंसियों के साथ मिलकर संयुक्त योजना और संचालन सुनिश्चित करना।

### आधुनिक युद्ध की बदलती प्रकृति और प्रौद्योगिकी

एयर चीफ मार्शल दीक्षित ने रेखांकित किया कि नई प्रौद्योगिकियाँ युद्ध की प्रकृति को मौलिक रूप से बदल रही हैं। उन्होंने उल्लेख किया कि आधुनिक सुरक्षा वातावरण में ड्रोन, लंबी दूरी के सटीक हथियार, साइबर युद्ध, अंतरिक्ष, कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) और इलेक्ट्रोमैग्नेटिक स्पेक्ट्रम जैसी तकनीकों की भूमिका बढ़ गई है। आगामी दशक में रणनीतिक श्रेष्ठता बनाए रखने के लिए वायु सेना को अपनी तकनीकों और रणनीतियों में निरंतर अनुकूलन करना होगा।

### 29वें वायु सेना प्रमुख का परिचय

*   **कमीशन और अनुभव:** दिसंबर 1986 में वायु सेना की फाइटर स्ट्रीम में शामिल हुए 59 वर्षीय कमांडर एक प्रायोगिक टेस्ट पायलट और योग्य फ्लाइंग इंस्ट्रक्टर हैं। उनके पास मिराज-2000, विभिन्न मिग मॉडल, जगुआर और तेजस LCA Mk-1 जैसे विमानों पर 3,500 से अधिक घंटों का उड़ान अनुभव है।
*   **प्रमुख पद:** वायु सेना प्रमुख बनने से पहले, उन्होंने उप वायु सेना प्रमुख, चीफ्स ऑफ स्टाफ कमेटी के अध्यक्ष के एकीकृत रक्षा स्टाफ प्रमुख (CISC), मध्य वायु कमान के एयर ऑफिसर कमांडिंग-इन-चीफ और डिप्टी चीफ ऑफ एयर स्टाफ के रूप में कार्य किया।
*   **परिचालन इतिहास:** उन्होंने 1999 के कारगिल युद्ध के दौरान ऑपरेशन सफेद सागर, जम्मू-कश्मीर में ऑपरेशन रक्षक और पहलगाम आतंकी हमले के बाद पाकिस्तान के साथ चार दिवसीय सैन्य गतिरोध के दौरान ऑपरेशन सिंदूर में CISC के रूप में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई।

news.full_article_text:
### ISRO Successfully Deploys NVS-03 Satellite for NavIC Augmentation

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) achieved another major spaceflight milestone with the successful launch of the NVS-03 navigation satellite. Designed to strengthen and sustain India's independent satellite navigation network, the NVS-03 mission expands the operational lifecycle and accuracy of the Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC) system.

### Strengthening India's Sovereign Navigation Infrastructure

NavIC, formerly designated as the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (IRNSS), provides high-precision positioning and timing services across the Indian subcontinent and its surrounding waters. The addition of NVS-03 to the constellation ensures uninterrupted coverage, better signal security, and improved performance for both civilian applications and strategic requirements.

hindi_translation.headline: इसरो ने भारत की नाविक (NavIC) नेविगेशन प्रणाली को मजबूत करने के लिए NVS-03 उपग्रह सफलतापूर्वक लॉन्च किया
hindi_translation.story_lead: भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO) ने NVS-03 नेविगेशन उपग्रह को सफलतापूर्वक कक्षा में स्थापित किया है। यह उपलब्धि क्षेत्र में कवरेज, सटीकता और परिचालन विश्वसनीयता में सुधार करके भारत की स्वदेशी क्षेत्रीय नेविगेशन प्रणाली 'नाविक' (NavIC) को सशक्त बनाती है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### इसरो ने नाविक प्रणाली के संवर्धन के लिए NVS-03 उपग्रह सफलतापूर्वक किया तैनात

भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO) ने NVS-03 नेविगेशन उपग्रह के सफल प्रक्षेपण के साथ अंतरिक्ष क्षेत्र में एक और महत्वपूर्ण मील का पत्थर हासिल किया है। भारत के स्वतंत्र उपग्रह नेविगेशन ढांचे को बनाए रखने और सुदृढ़ करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया यह मिशन, नाविक (NavIC) प्रणाली की क्षमता और सटीकता को बढ़ाता है।

### भारत के संप्रभु नेविगेशन ढांचे का सुदृढ़ीकरण

नाविक, जिसे पहले भारतीय क्षेत्रीय नेविगेशन उपग्रह प्रणाली (IRNSS) के रूप में जाना जाता था, भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप और आसपास के क्षेत्रों में सटीक समय और स्थिति सेवाएं प्रदान करता है। तारामंडल (constellation) में NVS-03 के शामिल होने से निर्बाध कवरेज, बेहतर सिग्नल सुरक्षा और नागरिक तथा रणनीतिक दोनों अनुप्रयोगों के लिए उन्नत प्रदर्शन सुनिश्चित होता है।
hindi_translation.background_context: विदेशी नेविगेशन प्रणालियों जैसे जीपीएस (GPS) पर रणनीतिक निर्भरता को कम करने के लिए इसरो द्वारा स्वतंत्र क्षेत्रीय नेविगेशन क्षमता के रूप में नाविक प्रणाली विकसित की गई थी।

यह प्रक्षेपण भारत की स्वदेशी नेविगेशन प्रणाली, नाविक (NavIC) को सीधे मजबूती प्रदान करता है।
NVS श्रृंखला के उपग्रह इसरो के अगली पीढ़ी के उपग्रह अपडेट का हिस्सा हैं जो पुराने IRNSS उपग्रहों को प्रतिस्थापित करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किए गए हैं।
नाविक प्रणाली भारत और उसके आसपास के क्षेत्रों में वास्तविक समय की स्थिति निर्धारण सेवाएं प्रदान करती है।
उपग्रह की सफल तैनाती से महत्वपूर्ण अंतरिक्ष-आधारित सेवाओं का निर्बाध संचालन सुनिश्चित होता है।
यह मिशन अंतरिक्ष अवसंरचना में भारत की आत्मनिर्भरता को प्रदर्शित करता है।

news.story_lead: 3 Kukis shot dead in Manipur gunfight Three Kuki men were killed in Manipur gunfire as Meitei and Naga groups rallied in Imphal to scrap the SoO pact with Kuki-Zo armed groups. Three Kuki men were killed in a fresh exchange of gunfire between unidentified armed groups in Manipur’s Noney district on Saturday, even as thousands of people, including members of Meitei and Naga organisations, held a rally in Imphal demanding the scrapping of the Suspension of Operations (SoO) agreement with Kuki-Zo armed groups and greater protection for local communities. news.full_article_text: 3 Kukis shot dead in Manipur gunfight Three Kuki men were killed in Manipur gunfire as Meitei and Naga groups rallied in Imphal to scrap the SoO pact with Kuki-Zo armed groups. Three Kuki men were killed in a fresh exchange of gunfire between unidentified armed groups in Manipur’s Noney district on Saturday, even as thousands of people, including members of Meitei and Naga organisations, held a rally in Imphal demanding the scrapping of the Suspension of Operations (SoO) agreement with Kuki-Zo armed groups and greater protection for local communities. The firing took place around 10am at Kekru Naga village under Nungba police station, officials aware of the matter said. Sporadic gunfire between unidentified groups suspected to belong to the Naga and Kuki communities had been reported in the area since October 29, said police, adding that Saturday’s incident was the first in three days to result in fatalities. According to police, security forces have been deployed in the area to maintain law and order. The three men have been identified as Thanglensang Singson, Thangkhosei Haokip and Lamminsang Kipgen, all residents of villages in Churachandpur district, police said. Kuki Inpi Manipur (KIM), a Kuki apex body, accused the National Socialist Council of Nagaland-Isak Muivah (NSCN-IM) and the Zeliangrong United Front-Kamson (ZUF-K) of responsibility for the killings. It said the three men were village volunteers. “The murder of these three brave village volunteers in Noney district is the direct consequence of the state’s reckless refusal to provide adequate security to vulnerable Kuki-Zo communities,” the organisation said in a statement. According to police, four automatic assault rifles, a single-barrel rifle, a drone, ammunition and improvised explosives were recovered from the site. Meanwhile, a massive rally, jointly organised by the Meitei and Naga communities, swept through Imphal on Saturday in what was arguably one of the largest public gatherings in Manipur since ethnic violence erupted in 2023. The high-turnout demonstration comes on the heels of a recent flare-up in tensions involving both groups and the Kuki-Zo community. They demanded the termination of the SoO agreement with Kuki-Zo armed groups and rehabilitation of families displaced by the ethnic conflict. The rally was jointly organised by the Coordinating Committee on Manipur Integrity (COCOMI), United Naga Council (UNC), Joint Tribes Council (JTC), Foot Hills Naga Coordinating Committee (FNCC), Naga People Union, Imphal (NPUI), Naga Humanitarian Aid Committee Manipur (NHACM), Manipur Naga Youth Organisation (MNYO), All Naga Students’ Association, Manipur (ANSAM), and people from the hills and valley. It came days after militants ambushed 14 Meitei men, killing three of them, sparking protests in the state. The conflict between Meitei and Kuki communities has claimed at least 306 lives so far, while clashes between Kuki and Naga groups have killed around 50 people since February. Officials said the march began at Tiddim Ground and concluded at Thangmeiband Athletic Union (THAU) ground in Imphal West. Police put up barricades at Keisampat junction, near Lok Bhavan, the chief minister’s office and the BJP state office, preventing the procession from moving further. No untoward incident was reported, said a senior police officer. At a public convention held at THAU ground, participants adopted a six-point resolution demanding an immediate end to what they described as the Centre’s “proxy war” and its support for “narco-terrorism”. They also sought the deployment of a neutral security force along the India-Myanmar border. The convention demanded that the SoO arrangement, which expired on September 24, not be extended under any circumstances. It called for the dismantling of designated camps, seizure of weapons and action against cadres accused of violating the agreement’s ground rules. The organisations also demanded permanent rehabilitation of internally displaced people (IDPs) since May 3, 2023, with adequate security, restoration of properties and livelihood support to enable their return. Another resolution sought the replacement of the Assam Rifles along the India-Myanmar border with a neutral, professionally trained force to prevent infiltration, trafficking and other cross-border crimes. The groups also demanded implementation of the National Register of Citizens (NRC), with 1951 as the base year, and the removal of deputy chief minister Nemcha Kipgen from the cabinet. They called for the government’s resignation if she was not removed. Naga organisations have accused Kipgen’s husband, Thangboi Kipgen, chairman of the Kuki National Front-Presidential faction, of involvement in civilian killings. Deputy chief minister Losii Dikho has also made the allegation. “Today, after three and a half years of crisis in Manipur, the indigenous people of the state, particularly the 21-22 tribes of the Nagas, the Meitei communities and several other ethnic groups, have come together to raise their voice against the government of India,” said Khuraijam Athouba, a former COCOMI convener. Athouba accused the Centre of failing to protect lives and property and said the agitation would continue until the demands were addressed. The Committee on Tribal Unity (CoTU) also held a parallel rally in Kangpokpi, citing threats to civilian lives and continued injustice against the Kuki-Zo community. It extended a total shutdown across the district by another 24 hours, citing the failure to secure the safe recovery of two missing Kuki civilians. It had earlier advised Kuki-Zo people against travelling beyond Kuki-inhabited areas of Sadar Hills. At a National Unity Day event in Imphal, chief minister Y Khemchand Singh said community-centric thinking could not ensure peace or economic progress. “A state cannot be governed by prioritising the interest of only one community,” he said.

Jaishankar also called for diplomacy over military action while addressing the G20 gathering. He said military solutions would not work in dealing with global challenges and stressed that diplomacy should be given a chance. The two-day gathering in Atlanta was hosted by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio. Russia's participation also became a point of tension, with several European representatives objecting to appearing alongside Lavrov in the traditional group photograph. Rubio eventually cancelled the group photo. The meeting ended without a joint communique as members failed to reach an agreement on several major issues. Instead, the United States planned to issue a chairman's statement outlining the discussions. Apart from Ukraine, the talks covered energy security, global supply chains, food security and the safety of important shipping routes, including the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea. news.story_lead: Supreme Court registers suo motu contempt case over Kerala Congress' derogatory post against CJI Surya Kant Converting separate letters addressed by two lawyers into a common petition on Friday, the court has tentatively listed the matter on November 6. The Supreme Court has registered a suo motu writ petition seeking contempt of court action against Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC) for publishing a derogatory post against Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant. Converting separate letters addressed by two lawyers – Vineet Jindal and Sreejesh SR – into a common petition on Friday, the registry of the Supreme Court has tentatively listed the matter to November 6.
news.full_article_text: Supreme Court registers suo motu contempt case over Kerala Congress' derogatory post against CJI Surya Kant Converting separate letters addressed by two lawyers into a common petition on Friday, the court has tentatively listed the matter on November 6. The Supreme Court has registered a suo motu writ petition seeking contempt of court action against Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC) for publishing a derogatory post against Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant. Converting separate letters addressed by two lawyers – Vineet Jindal and Sreejesh SR – into a common petition on Friday, the registry of the Supreme Court has tentatively listed the matter to November 6. Track live updates on anti-SIR protest Jindal wrote a letter to the CJI on October 13 citing a post published by KPCC on ‘X’ that was subsequently deleted. The post published addressed the CJI as “Dear Surya Kant” and stated, “If law and order is not your domain, resign now. We will find your replacement who can handle it.” The post that kicked up a row was published on October 12 amid the hearing by the top court on a bunch of petitions seeking probe into excesses by the Delhi Police during the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protests in the capital city. Also read: Kharge accuses CEC Gyanesh Kumar of 'treason', levels 6 charges during INDIA bloc's mock impeachment Following the controversial post, the two bar associations of the Supreme Court – Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA) and Supreme Court Advocates on Record Association (SCOARA) – condemned the demand for CJI’s resignation. The two associations had issued resolutions stating that such a statement borders on contempt as it undermines public confidence in the judiciary and amounts to interference in the administration of justice. Pursuant to this, SCBA joint secretary Meneesh Dubey had issued a legal notice to KPCC President Sunny Joseph on October 16 seeking response on the said post. Subsequently, on October 22, KPCC president responded to the legal notice and said the post was published by one Vijay Thottathil of the KPCC media cell “without the prior knowledge, approval or consultation of the KPCC leadership”. Joseph in his reply said, “Neither I nor the leadership had authorised him to demand the resignation of the CJI or to suggest that the organisation would find a replacement.” Though it admitted that the official account of the party was used for such an “unauthorised communication”, it stated that it does not establish that its contents were approved by the leadership. Thottathil has since been removed from the position and he has been called upon to issue a public apology for the said publication, the response further stated. “The KPCC disapproves of and expressly disagrees with, censures the language employed in the post. The demand for resignation and the suggestion of finding a replacement for the CJI were inappropriate and should not have appeared on an official party platform,” it stated. Jindal’s letter urged the court to take suo motu cognisance of initiating criminal contempt on the post stating that the issue raises a larger question. Jindal said, “The office of the Chief Justice of India is a constitutional judicial office and cannot be treated as one whose continuance is subject to the approval or displeasure of any political organisation.” He further states, “Legitimate criticism must be distinguished from conduct that may undermine the authority of the court or interfere with the administration of justice. The distinction must be assessed in the light of the language used, its context, the circumstances of publication and its actual or reasonably apprehended effect.” Also read: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit takes charge as new IAF chief amid modernisation push He brought to the court’s attention the reported political demonstration and slogan-shouting by Congress leaders and other Opposition leaders inside the Supreme Court premises on October 12 when Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi along with other political party leaders came with a large gathering of lawyers to file their petition challenging the special intensive revision (SIR) and the functioning of Election Commission of India posing a security threat within the court’s precincts. Linking the two events – the demonstration and the tweet – Jindal said, “In order to ascertain the true and complete facts concerning the reported events, I respectfully request that the competent authority consider preserving and examining the relevant material, wherever available, including the original social-media publication by INC Keralam (@INCKerala), its URL, date and time of publication, account details, surrounding statements and available electronic records.” It also sought preservation of CCTV footage covering the entry gates and areas within the court, entry registers, access control logs, security deployment records and verified video recordings and other material. The top court is also examining a petition filed by SCBA against Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut and journalist Nikhil Wagle for their derogatory posts against the CJI and the judiciary in relation to the October 12 events. A bench headed by justice Aravind Kumar had earlier this week directed Raut to appear physically before the court while Wagle was permitted to appear virtually.

news.headline: ISRO Successfully Launches NVS-03 Satellite to Enhance India's NavIC Navigation Network
news.story_lead: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has successfully launched the NVS-03 satellite into orbit. This mission provides a strategic boost to NavIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation), strengthening India's self-reliant positioning and navigation infrastructure.
news.full_article_text:
### ISRO Launches NVS-03 Satellite for NavIC Augmentation

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) achieved another key space mission milestone with the successful orbital deployment of the NVS-03 satellite. The satellite is designed to strengthen and ensure the operational continuity of India's indigenous regional satellite navigation network, known as NavIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation).

### Key Mission Highlights & Operational Importance
* **System Enhancement:** The deployment of NVS-03 reinforces the satellite constellation responsible for delivering real-time positioning and timing services across the Indian mainland and adjacent regional areas.
* **Next-Generation Capabilities:** NVS-03 belongs to the second-generation series of navigation satellites (NVS) developed to expand regional coverage, improve user position accuracy, and support both civilian and strategic applications.
* **Boosting Technological Autonomy:** The continuous deployment of NVS series satellites underpins India's initiative to maintain independent regional positioning capabilities without relying exclusively on global satellite systems like GPS.
bullet_points: ISRO successfully launched the NVS-03 navigation satellite into orbit.
The mission enhances the operational capacity and signal continuity of the NavIC constellation.
NVS-03 is part of the second-generation navigation satellite series developed by ISRO.
NavIC provides accurate positioning and timing services over India and surrounding regions.
The satellite mission supports both civilian commercial applications and national strategic requirements.
The successful launch reflects ongoing national efforts to strengthen independent satellite navigation infrastructure.
key_facts: NVS-03 is a second-generation navigation satellite launched by ISRO.
NavIC stands for Navigation with Indian Constellation.
The launch aims to maintain continuity and enhance coverage of regional positioning services.
important_dates: October 31, 2026: ISRO successfully deployed the NVS-03 satellite.
exam_relevance: Prelims: Knowledge of ISRO's NVS series, NavIC coverage area, and regional satellite navigation architecture.
Mains: GS Paper 3 (Science & Technology) - India's space program, satellite navigation infrastructure, and self-reliance in strategic technologies.
news.upsc_analysis: The successful deployment of NVS-03 marks a crucial step in ensuring the operational longevity and precision of India's NavIC network. Robust regional navigation reduces dependency on foreign GPS networks, thereby safeguarding critical infrastructure, aviation, maritime transit, and national security capabilities.
causes: Need to reinforce and update the existing constellation of India's indigenous NavIC navigation system.
impacts: Enhances regional navigation coverage and positioning accuracy across India.
Strengthens strategic self-reliance in space-based positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) services.
government_steps: Development and deployment of the next-generation NVS satellite series by ISRO under the Department of Space.
way_forward: Ensure timely launches of remaining NVS series satellites to maintain continuous, high-precision positioning services across all operational domains.
news.mains_notes:
### NavIC and NVS Satellite Series
- **Purpose:** Provide independent real-time positioning and timing services over India and a 1,500 km extended boundary.
- **NVS Series Role:** Next-generation satellite series designed to replace older IRNSS satellites, introducing upgraded atomic clocks and enhanced signal capabilities for both public and defense sectors.

भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (आरबीआई) के गवर्नर के बयानों के अनुसार, वर्ष 2026 में वैश्विक आर्थिक विकास पथ में मामूली वृद्धि दर्ज किए जाने का अनुमान है।
